'''Roasted Hazelnuts''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Roasted Hazelnuts per year on [[Kent]]'s birthday, [[Spring|Spring 4]].

==Tailoring==
Roasted Hazelnuts is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt053.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
